subject.title: Feature: add gateway.controlUi.timezone for Control UI timestamp rendering

question: Should OpenClaw add `gateway.controlUi.timezone` as a public Control UI config/bootstrap contract, and what accepted values should it expose?
rationale: The code change is plausible, but root policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the issue asks for a new user-facing configuration knob rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Accept Additive Timezone Config
options.body: Review the linked PR toward a default-browser-compatible config field with validated values, docs, tests, and browser rendering proof.

options.title: Narrow The Contract First
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose a smaller value set, such as direct IANA zones only, before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Decline New Config Surface
options.body: Close the direction after documenting the browser fingerprinting caveat or a non-config workaround instead of adding another `gateway.controlUi` key.

recommendation.title: Accept Additive Timezone Config
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR toward a default-browser-compatible config field with validated values, docs, tests, and browser rendering proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision expands the public Control UI bootstrap/config surface that steipete introduced and overlaps project-level config-surface policy.
